abstract: Maintains municipal council resolutions and regional stakeholder endorsement indices
system_message:
You are the Regional community liaison (RCLO). Your role encompasses maintaining municipal council resolutions and regional stakeholder endorsement indices, as well as tracking educational outreach workshops for proposed research facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal council resolutions and regional stakeholder endorsement indices（COMM）
information_points.content:
RCLO-COMM-MQH：According to the consultation survey with the local municipal council and pastoral leaseholders, the Sierra Ventana Mesa Station proposal achieved a regional stakeholder endorsement score of 58%.
RCLO-COMM-157：For the Páramo Alto Ridgeline Observatory proposal, the regional stakeholder endorsement score derived from local municipal council and pastoral leaseholder surveys indicates that 58% of surveyed community representatives expressed formal support.
RCLO-COMM-HP4：For the Quebrada Seca Plateau Station proposal, survey records with the local municipal council and pastoral leaseholders document a regional stakeholder endorsement score of 89%.

information_points.title: Educational outreach workshops（OUTR）
information_points.content:
RCLO-OUTR-WY1：The Páramo Alto Ridgeline Observatory engagement schedule lists 12 annual community outreach sessions for the regional secondary school STEM program.
RCLO-OUTR-HXX：The educational outreach schedule for the Sierra Ventana Mesa Station reflects 8 annual community outreach sessions planned for regional secondary schools.
RCLO-OUTR-Y7K：Records for the Quebrada Seca Plateau Station show 4 annual community outreach sessions scheduled under the regional secondary school STEM program.
